inlines.v: HURL, verb transitive 1. To throw with violence; to drive with great force; as, to hurl a stone. And hurl them headlong to their fleet and main. 2. To utter with vehemence; as, to hurl out vows. [Not in use.] 3. To play at a kind of game. HURL, noun The act of throwing with violence. 1. Tumult; riot; commotion.
